An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 552 identities would post 2784 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
